notes: Two taḥwīl-free routes: the first ends at Shababa, the second at al-Zuhri; the text writes no names shared by both.
«بإسناد ابن حنبل عن حماد، ومعناه» gives a different transmitter for the same meaning: a variant group, not a route of the main saying (rule 4).
«- المعنى -» and «قال مخلد لم يناد» are editor's and wording remarks, left out.
